segments.comment: wintty.c render_status() lines the third row's Blind condition up with the hunger column and stores that column as its x, so every later check_fields() pass redraws it and its indent blanks the unchanged Shield and terrain fields. A terrain word that gets shorter is redrawn and the rest-of-line erase takes Blind with it until the next pass; the turn counter reaching two digits moves every later field, which redraws them all.
